title: If I Had the Chance
gist_ar: رسالة عن أحلام وأمنيات لو الظروف اتغيرت.
text:
Dear Mona,

You asked me a difficult question: what would I do if I had the chance to change my life? I have been thinking about it all week.

If I were a millionaire, I don't think I would stop working. I would probably invest some of the money in a small school, because I would like to give other people the opportunity that I did not have. I would donate a part of it too, but I wouldn't tell anybody.

If I could travel anywhere tomorrow, I would choose Japan. I wish I spoke Japanese! I imagine walking in a quiet street there in spring.

The honest answer, though, is that I would change very little. If I quit my job and spent every day travelling, I think I would miss my students. Sometimes we dream about a different life, and then we discover that we would choose the same one again.

What about you? What would you do?

Layla

questions.q: What would Layla do if she were a millionaire?
questions.q_ar: لو كانت مليونيرة كانت عملت إيه؟

questions.q: Why would she invest in a school?
options: To give others an opportunity she did not have
